distanceDefinition: Euclidean eye-to-target distance; horizontal placement is adjusted to preserve height and azimuth.

independentProjectionSamples.bodyAndHurtEnvelopes: All sampled envelopes fit including tested +5-unit rises.
independentProjectionSamples.limitation: Conservative weapon corners can clip at extreme foreground-rim poses. Most such samples are below the floor or outside the active boundary; a small residual ear-tip risk remains. Floor/body fit is not an all-pose weapon visibility guarantee.
